name: Espresso
description: Single-origin Ethiopian Yirgacheffe pulled as a classic espresso shot. Bright citrus notes with a delicate floral finish.

name: Cappuccino
description: Rich espresso topped with silky steamed milk and a thick layer of microfoam. A balanced classic with a light cocoa finish.

name: Cafe Latte
description: Smooth espresso layered with steamed milk and a whisper of foam. Creamy and gentle with notes of caramel.

name: Flat White
description: Double ristretto shot married with velvety micro-foamed milk. Bold and rounded with a nutty undertone.

name: Single-Origin Pour-Over
description: Hand-poured Chikmagalur beans brewed drip-style for a clean cup. Notes of stone fruit and honeyed sweetness shine through.

name: South Indian Filter Coffee
description: Traditional filter-brewed decoction blended with frothy hot milk. Deep chicory-kissed aroma and comforting sweetness.

name: Cold Brew
description: Single-origin Coorg beans steeped slow and cold for eighteen hours. Smooth low-acid body with notes of dark chocolate and caramel.

name: Iced Latte
description: Chilled espresso poured over cold milk and ice. Light and creamy with a subtle sweetness.

name: Nitro Cold Brew
description: Cold brew infused with nitrogen for a cascading creamy pour. Velvety texture with a naturally sweet finish.

name: Affogato
description: A scoop of vanilla bean gelato drowned in a hot espresso shot. Warm and cold in one indulgent sip.

name: Iced Americano
description: Espresso shots stretched over chilled water and ice. Crisp and refreshing with bright acidity.

name: Classic Cold Coffee
description: Chilled coffee blended with milk and a scoop of ice cream. A nostalgic favorite topped with chocolate shavings.

name: Masala Chai
description: Robust Assam tea simmered with ginger and warming spices. Sweet milky and deeply comforting.

name: Darjeeling First Flush
description: Delicate high-altitude leaves steeped for a light muscatel cup. Floral and subtly fruity.

name: Assam Golden Tip
description: Full-bodied malty tea from the Brahmaputra valley. Bold and brisk with a honeyed finish.

name: Jasmine Green Tea
description: Green tea leaves scented with fresh jasmine blossoms. Light floral aroma with a clean grassy finish.

name: Nilgiri Iced Tea
description: Chilled Nilgiri tea brewed bright and lightly sweetened. Fragrant and refreshing over ice.

name: Chamomile Herbal Infusion
description: Caffeine-free chamomile flowers steeped for a soothing cup. Gentle honeyed and floral.

name: Butter Croissant
description: Laminated French-style pastry baked until golden and flaky. Buttery layers with a delicate crisp shell.

name: Almond Croissant
description: Buttery croissant filled with almond cream and topped with toasted almonds. Rich nutty and lightly sweet.

name: Chocolate Hazelnut Tart
description: Dark chocolate ganache set in a crisp tart shell with roasted hazelnuts. Decadent and silky.

name: Banana Walnut Bread
description: Moist banana loaf studded with toasted walnuts. Warm caramelized sweetness in every slice.

name: Blueberry Muffin
description: Soft vanilla muffin loaded with juicy blueberries. Lightly crumbled sugar topping for extra crunch.

name: Cardamom Bun
description: Swedish-style yeasted bun swirled with cardamom and cinnamon sugar. Warm spiced and pillowy soft.

name: Classic Club Sandwich
description: Toasted bread layered with chicken bacon egg lettuce and tomato. Hearty and satisfying with a smoky finish.

name: Caprese Grilled Sandwich
description: Fresh mozzarella and tomato with basil pesto on grilled ciabatta. Light and herbaceous with a tangy finish.

name: Paneer Tikka Sandwich
description: Chargrilled paneer tossed in tandoori spices layered with mint chutney and onions. Smoky and tangy with a satisfying bite.

name: Smoked Chicken and Cheese Panini
description: Smoked chicken and melted cheddar pressed between rustic bread. Warm gooey and deeply savory.

name: Avocado and Hummus Sandwich
description: Creamy avocado and hummus layered with sprouts and cucumber on multigrain bread. Fresh light and packed with texture.

name: Bombay Masala Toast
description: Spiced potato filling grilled between buttered bread with green chutney. A street-food classic done cafe-style.

name: Siphon Brewed Single Origin
description: Theatrical vacuum-brewed coffee using rare Kerala Monsooned Malabar beans. Clean and full-bodied with earthy spice notes.

name: Aeropress Flight
description: Two single-origin beans brewed side-by-side for a guided tasting. A hands-on journey through terroir and roast.

name: Coffee Cupping Flight
description: Three microlot coffees tasted the way roasters do it. Guided flavor notes from floral to chocolatey.

name: Chef's All-Day Breakfast Platter
description: Eggs your way with sourdough toast sauteed mushrooms and herbed potatoes. A hearty plate built for lingering mornings.

name: Filter Coffee Tiramisu
description: Classic tiramisu soaked in South Indian filter coffee instead of espresso. Creamy mascarpone with a distinctly Indian twist.

name: Malabar Spiced Mocha
description: Espresso blended with dark chocolate and a warm Kerala Malabar spice mix finished with steamed milk and a dusting of cocoa. Rich earthy and gently spiced.
